result.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
result.comment: Paper was accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence (ODI) and the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). OpenReview ODI: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Y6fgNlFNL6, OpemReview SLM: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Hhqi8DIZaG
result.summary: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple but can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs. Under the common benchmark, all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs. CUDA kernel designs transfer only partially: public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, and batch-one decode makes several serving-oriented mechanisms inapplicable, although transferable components yield up to 1.20 times decode throughput. Quantization gains vary by machine. Across four families, a reported speedup is not a portable property of a technique alone but a joint function of technique, runtime, hardware contract, and workload regime.

AI.brief_summary: 在四台 Apple 设备与匹配的 RTX 4090 上以统一的单请求解码负载评测 KV-cache 剪枝、投机解码、移植 GPU kernel 与训练后量化，发现多数服务端加速手段在 Apple Silicon 上失效、收益随硬件与运行时变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 latent 推理状态机制无直接关联，但其「加速比是技术、运行时、硬件契约与负载共同函数」的结论，可供核查 LVR 中多步 latent／thinking 计算的额外开销在本地或异构平台上的成本核算是否被高估。
